name: Small Garage
about: Hand-built 1:43 replicas of classic American and European cars. Resin bodies, photo-etched brass trim, paint mixed to match the original colour. Lena builds in small batches and keeps a shelf of finished cars ready to ship; made-to-order builds go into the next batch.

listings.title: Green American Fastback, 1968
listings.materials: resin body, photo-etched brass trim, turned aluminium wheels
listings.paint: deep highland green, mixed by hand (our code 68-G)
listings.notes: Opening-free display model. Comes on a black wood plinth with a dust cover. Not a toy, not for children under 14.
